newsitem.title: UK: Major sees Labour tax cut reverse in July.
newsitem.headline: Major sees Labour tax cut reverse in July.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major on Friday predicted that the penny in the pound cut in income tax which takes effect this weekend would be "wiped out" by a July budget if Labour wins the May 1 election.
Speaking at a campaign news conference, Major predicted "an emergency budget within 10 weeks of the election, a budget whose sole purpose would be to put taxes up."
"So at one stroke this weekend's tax cut could be wiped out in July," he said.
"I want people to know while we are two days away from Conservative tax cuts, we could be just weeks away from the first Labour tax rise," Major said.
